tool_args.rationale: Fit the recalled sink-gradient law numerically and use fresh confirmation to test it. All paid gradients are below the stated avalanche threshold, so the avalanche strength and threshold are not identifiable from these observations; their fitted values remain initialization-dependent.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The recalled sink-gradient mechanism explicitly accounts for the observed concave response and gradient dependence; the alternatives omit that specified sink mechanism.
The unresolved avalanche behavior concerns gradients above the threshold, not trajectory resolution; the available menu does not offer the specified high-gradient probe.
The nuisance measurement is irrelevant to the mechanism.
